sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: The VW Buzz Configurator delivered a 7x increase in order conversion by enabling customers to visualize custom wrap designs in real-time 3D. The WebGL-powered experience maintained 60fps performance across devices while generating 3x longer session times compared to static imagery.

sections.title: 3D Visualization Success
highlights: 60fps real-time rendering across desktop and mobile
3x longer average session time vs static imagery
Direct integration with Wrapmate ordering system

sections.title: Business Results
sections.summary: The configurator eliminated customer hesitation by providing accurate wrap visualization before purchase. Users can explore unlimited design combinations instantly, building confidence in their customization choices. The seamless order integration reduced the sales cycle from days to minutes.

businessRequirements.businessContext: Transform the Volkswagen Buzz experience with a real-time wrap visualizer, enabling visualization and customization of accent graphics at the touch of a button
businessRequirements.problemStatement: Customers cannot visualize custom wrap designs on their vehicle before ordering, leading to hesitation and lost sales
